verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe official unified SDKs with the same API surface across web, mobile, server and game engines. They share an identity, event and consent model, and include Experiment SDKs with local flag evaluation, autocapture, and named Flutter and React Native SDKs. A Wizard CLI detects the framework and installs the right SDK, which suits AI-native setup. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs working well (one community report calls integration hard and the data often wrong), and a full per-language SDK list with reference/versioning detail.
